visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a brightly lit retail environment with teal-colored walls and a sign that reads "FISH & CHIPS". A female staff member wearing a patterned apron and a leopard print hat is seen behind a service counter, handling what appears to be a plush food item wrapped in paper. The lighting is bright studio style, illuminating the colorful surroundings. (2) The scene shifts to a wider view of the department store interior, identified as Selfridges by an overlay. Large crowds of shoppers are visible in the background, browsing shelves filled with various plush toys. The environment is spacious with modern retail displays and warm ambient lighting mixed with natural light. (3) The main character, a woman with long brownish hair wearing a black jacket, is seen interacting playfully with the store staff. They perform a series of hand gestures, tossing a plush chip back and forth as if it were too hot to touch, laughing and smiling with high energy. (4) Close-up shots follow, showing the staff member carefully wrapping the plush items in blue and white printed paper and securing them with a sticker. A branded "Jellycat" shopping bag is shown as the items are placed inside by the staff, who maintains a friendly facial expression. (5) A montage sequence displays a vast array of Jellycat plush toys organized on shelves, including yellow parrots, turtles, Halloween-themed figures like pumpkins and black cats, and Christmas-themed bears and bunnies. The camera moves quickly across these colorful displays using fast cuts and handheld pans.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 英國限定 Jellycat炸魚薯條. 不管幾歲的人. (2) [Subtitle]: 只要到了Jellycat. 都會變回小孩. (3) [Subtitle]: 這次到英國有個重要任務. (4) [Subtitle]: 就是一定要去逛Jellycat 大家要記得. 如果你想買英國限定的炸魚薯條的話. (5) [Slogan]: Selfridges 官網就可以預約. (6) [Subtitle]: 一定要記得在網站上面預約. 預約時間到了再去. 就不用排隊. (7) [Subtitle]: 不然現場的人潮你絕對會嚇死. 估計要排2個小時以上. (8) [Variety]: 只買娃娃跟吊飾不用預約喔. (9) [Subtitle]: 店員非常認真的跟你互動. 你會變得很感動. 就像是小時候跟姐妹玩辦家家酒一樣. (10) [Variety]: \so hot/. (11) [Subtitle]: 她說薯條很燙. 希望我可以幫薯條降溫. 我們兩個就在那邊拋來拋去. 真的超可愛. (12) [Variety]: |真香|. (13) [Subtitle]: 店員說很多台灣人來買. 這個貼紙上還會印名字！！ 店員：妳回去會到處都看到炸魚薯條😂. (14) [Variety]: 還有徵章. 貼紙. (15) [Subtitle]: 還有徵章. 貼紙. 太可愛了. (16) [Variety]: 現場超多款式. 還有萬聖節款. 還有聖誕節系列. 棉花糖指定的鯡魚罐頭. 每一款都太可愛了 好想要啊. 來英國一定要來看看.

The BGM continues, but the sound of crisp paper rustling becomes prominent as the assistant handles packaging materials. A soft metallic thud is heard from the counter.
